verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page confirms that ported numbers are supported ("One new or ported phone number... per user"), so porting an existing number in is a documented capability. Nothing in the evidence describes how the port works: collecting the losing carrier's account details, gathering a letter of authorization, or Quo filing the port on the user's behalf. Missing for 10: documentation of the port-in workflow, collection of losing-carrier account details and PIN, LOA capture, provider-filed port submission and status tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my existing number in: the provider collects the losing carrier's account details and letter of authorization and files the port

citations.quote: One new or ported phone number (local or toll-free) per user
